issue.title: bob capture -f json omits code for orphaned_nested_bullet, empty_child_after_markers, and malformed invalid_child_line
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-on.6.1.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3), triaged by the bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent. bob capture's JSON error output carries no `code` for three generic child-line structural errors that capture-parse already codes.

task_type_fields.impact: Clients that branch on `bob capture -f json` `code` (Bob Mac Capture's submit/preview error handling, scripts) cannot tell these structural errors apart and the dry-run/capture-parse parity the requirement-bullets work established covers only the req codes. Pre-existing; not caused by bob-cli-on.6.1.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture_language/item.rs (CaptureItemParseError child-line errors) and the capture code_for_message tables
task_type_fields.repro:
Against a vault with `work.md` (any content), run `bob capture --dry-run -f json -- "<draft>"` and `bob capture-parse -f json -- "<draft>"`:

- `@work T\n  - orphan nested` → capture JSON has no `code` (message "…is a nested bullet but has no preceding first-level authored…"); capture-parse reports `orphaned_nested_bullet`.
- `@work T\n- ok\n   - odd indent` → capture JSON has no `code` ("…must be a column-zero bullet or a two-space nested bullet…"); capture-parse reports `invalid_child_line`.
- `@work T\n- note\n  - nn\n    - deep` (level 3 under a note, the requirement-hint path) → capture JSON reports `code: invalid_child_line`, as expected.

Reproduced on master 3ce97d73. The generic child-line errors in the main item path (`capture_language/item.rs` → `CaptureItemParseError`, plus the `code_for_message` tables in `capture/`) still carry no code, so `empty_child_after_markers`, `orphaned_nested_bullet`, and malformed-line `invalid_child_line` are uncoded in `bob capture -f json` while `capture-parse` codes them. Fix: route these through `coded(...)` with the same codes `capture-parse` emits and add a dry-run/capture-parse code-parity case for each (extend `tests/cli/capture/reqs_refusals.rs::dry_run_and_capture_parse_agree_on_codes_and_depths` or a sibling).

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-on.6.1.2 (note #3) during the requirement-bullets epic; the bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent re-verified it on master and it predates that epic.

payload.entry: Also verified: '@work T\n- [ ] \n  - child' (empty requirement with children) → bob capture JSON has no code while capture-parse reports empty_child_after_markers. All three named codes are uncoded in bob capture JSON on 3ce97d73.

payload.description: Proposed this follow-up (note #3) and added the coded req_* refusals plus the dry-run/capture-parse parity test this fix should extend
